# benchmark-sycophancy

> Will a model go along with a bad plan as the harm rises?

Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/benchmark-sycophancy
Repository: https://github.com/pooriaarab/benchmark-sycophancy
Directory: https://private-repo-337e.com/benchmarks/benchmark-sycophancy

## Exports

The root exports `benchmark`, `run`, and `score`. `benchmark-sycophancy/api` exports the fetch-style `handler`. `benchmark-sycophancy/mcp` exports MCP builders.

## Commands

The CLI supports list, show, run, score, card, provenance, index-entry, serve, and mcp. Use the mock provider for offline verification.

## Verification

Run `npm run ci:local`. The report is `artifacts/e2e-report.json`.
